artworks.title: Home Sweet Home Cottage, No. 3, Easthampton
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic, vine-covered house. The house fills the entire frame, with a symmetrical facade featuring windows and a slightly open door revealing a staircase inside. The etching technique creates detailed textures of the vines, shadows, and reflections on the windows. The color scheme is monochrome in shades of black and grey. Sunlight filters through tree branches, framing the house.

artworks.title: A Long Island Windmill
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 11.1 x 27.1 cm (4 3/8 x 10 11/16 in.)
sheet (irregular): 17.1 x 39 cm (6 3/4 x 15 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a stone windmill, a church spire in the distance, foliage, and a path. The drawing uses fine lines characteristic of an etching style. The color palette is minimal, relying on light and shadow for depth. Fields and buildings can be seen extending towards distant hills.

artworks.title: The Old Mulford House
artworks.description: The image is a black and white drawing of a rustic house viewed straight on. The house is set in a flat landscape, flanked by trees on both sides. The drawing is detailed, with cross-hatching used for texture and shadows on the trees and house. The color scheme is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and gray. Vegetation or ground cover is seen in the foreground, leading the eye to the house with multi-paned windows and a partially open door. In the background, the upper part of the house and sky are depicted.

artworks.title: The Church Tower, Portsmouth
artworks.description: A scene featuring a body of water and a village. Boats are docked near a pier, leading to the village. Trees and a church steeple are visible in the background. The village has traditional architecture with peaked roofs and varied windows. The image is created using detailed etching and cross-hatching techniques. The color scheme is monochromatic. Tall trees surround the village, and light clouds are suggested in the sky.

artworks.title: The "Home Sweet Home" Cottage, Easthampton
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic house surrounded by lush vegetation. The perspective is straight-on, showcasing the house's facade. The scene features the house, trees, and foliage, with no visible horizon. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing textures such as the shingles and leaves. The monochromatic color palette uses sepia tones for depth. Sunlight filters through leaves, creating dappled light and shadow on the ground.

artworks.title: Shipping Along the Molo in Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a coastal scene with boats featuring red sails and figures moving about. Buildings, including a church with a tall tower and green and white spire, are visible in the distance. A sky with swirling clouds in beige, blue, and soft yellow hues is depicted. The color palette combines earthy tones with soft pastels. The brushwork gives the scene a gentle and airy quality.

artworks.title: Mount Tacoma
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on blue wove paper

artworks.title: A Venetian Lagoon
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and gouache over graphite, with white heightening, on blue-gray wove paper

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.description: This print shows two women standing closely together. The woman on the left has curly, shoulder-length hair and is dressed in a long, draped garment. Her right arm is holding what appears to be the severed head of a bearded man with curly hair. She is leaning forward, placing the head into a bag which the woman on the right is holding open for her. Both women are looking downward towards the head. The woman on the right appears slightly older, and she wears a headscarf and a dress with designs around the hem. Both women have sandals on their feet. The background depicts a scene with trees on the left, distant architectural structures on the right, and an empty sky.

artworks.title: L'ancien Louvre d'après une peinture de Zeeman, 1651 (The Old Louvre, from a Painting by Zeeman, l651)
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon, after Reinier Nooms (called Zeeman)
artworks.medium: etching with graphite additions on laid Hudelist paper
artworks.description: The image features a riverside scene with a large building in the center and smaller structures in the background. The sky is filled with clouds, and there are boats on the water. The artwork is done in an etching style, with detailed lines showing architectural elements, boats, and water ripples. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of brown and black.

artworks.title: The Death of Tancred [left]
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of people gathered in an ornate classical setting. The interior features tall columns, an arched ceiling, and intricate architectural details. In the center, figures are closely gathered, suggesting an emotional moment. The background includes a round window or shield, adding to the dramatic atmosphere. The drawing is detailed with fine shading and precise line work.

artworks.title: The Challenge [right]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set in classical architecture. The artwork depicts multiple figures gathered in an architectural setting with large columns and archways. The central figure is interacting with a figure sitting or kneeling on the ground, while both are adorned in classical attire. The detailing of the clothing and architectural elements adds depth, and the lines and cross-hatching techniques create a sense of movement and emotion. The title "TANCREDE" at the bottom suggests a narrative or character from literature or legend.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.9 x 43.9 cm (11 3/8 x 17 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a crowd. The composition features figures, some on horses, surrounding a large wooden beam with intricate textures. The figures display different postures and clothing details, showcasing interaction. The drawing conveys movement and activity with elements like leaning bodies and extended arms. In the background, there are landscape features like hills and a town. The artwork's detailing includes fabric folds, facial expressions, and spatial depth, suggesting a significant narrative or event.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 11.1 x 7.9 cm (4 3/8 x 3 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.dimensions: overall: 11 x 7.9 cm (4 5/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene showing a central figure surrounded by two others under an architectural arch. The central figure has a halo around the head and is partially covered by a draped cloth, standing on a pedestal. To either side stand figures in medieval attire, each holding an implement. The left figure holds a multi-thonged object, while the right figure appears poised to strike with a leafy bundle. The background consists of stylized architectural elements, such as arches, creating an enclosed space. The use of color is simple yet bold, characteristic of medieval illustrative style. This is in the style of a medieval woodblock print or manuscript illumination.

artworks.title: The Carrying of the Cross
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 11 x 7.9 cm (4 5/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This woodblock print showing a man carrying a T-shaped cross surrounded by five other people is created with black outlines, which are colored in with washes of red, tan, green, and yellow. Some unpainted areas of the paper remain cream white, including the faces and hands of the people. At the center of the composition, the man carrying the cross, Jesus, is shown bearded and wearing a long tan robe. He bends over facing our right as he carries the cross across his shoulders and along his back. A green band encircles his head and a yellow halo with three red points surrounds his head. Faint red drops trickle down his face. He looks back to our left toward a person supporting the long end of the cross. That bearded person wears a green cowl over his head and shoulders, a red tunic, yellow stockings, and black shoes. A man wearing a helmet and carrying a hammer pulls a rope tied around Jesus's waist. Another man behind Jesus to our left wears a red robe and cap, and points to our right. Two haloed women with white cloths covering their heads and red and white garments follow the cross to our left.

artworks.title: Christ Stripped of His Garment
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring four figures in a scene. In the center, there is a figure wearing a cloth around their waist and a halo. Another figure to the right is gently touching the central figure. There is a figure on the left with an arm raised. Behind the central figure, there is a person wearing a cloak and hat. The background shows a green field and neutral sky. The style of the painting is reminiscent of European religious art from the late Middle Ages or early Renaissance periods.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 11.1 x 8 cm (4 3/8 x 3 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene with figures on either side of the cross. The central figure is on a cross, with two figures standing on each side. The central figure is draped in a cloth around the waist, with visible rib cage details, and a halo behind their head. The figure on the left appears somber, with hands clasped near the chest, cloaked in heavy drapery, and a matching halo. To the right, another figure stands, holding a book, with a similar halo. The painting features deep linework and earthy tones, minimal background details of cracked earth and a sparse patch of green. The style is reminiscent of medieval woodcut illustrations.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 11.1 x 8 cm (4 3/8 x 3 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene depicting a crucifixion. The painting illustrates the figure on the cross being embraced tenderly by an individual standing on a ladder, set against a sparse background. Three figures with halo-like attributes sit or kneel beneath, with expressions of grief and piety, while the figure on the ladder appears to be assisting the central figure. This is in the style of medieval religious woodcuts. The use of flat colors and clear outlines, typical of the period, creates a solemn and impactful depiction of the scene.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 11.1 x 7.9 cm (4 3/8 x 3 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group gathered around a deceased figure. The image shows a somber scene with figures wearing halos positioned around a central figure laid inside a rectangular structure, possibly a tomb. The figures wear robes of varying colors, including red, green, and muted ochre. One person is holding the arm of the central figure, who has a crown of thorns and appears lifeless. There are no elaborate backgrounds, focusing the viewer's attention on the subjects and their emotive expressions. The style features bold outlines and a limited color palette, with an illustrative quality reminiscent of early religious woodcuts or manuscript illustrations. This is in the style of Master of the Playing Cards.

artworks.title: Christ in Limbo
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 11.2 x 8 cm (4 7/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene with divine and infernal elements. The image shows a central figure wearing a halo and a red robe, holding a staff topped with a cross. The central figure extends a hand towards several imprisoned figures. Flames emerge from the openings of a building, with a demonic figure atop it. The scene suggests a narrative of salvation or liberation from a fiery place. The painting uses bold outlines and a limited color palette, emphasizing red and gold tones. This is in the style of Lucas Cranach the Elder, featuring religious iconography and storytelling through a woodcut aesthetic.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 11.2 x 7.9 cm (4 7/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a figure walking on a structure while holding a flag with a cross. The central figure has long hair, a beard, and a halo around the head, dressed in a red robe standing on a rectangular structure. The figure is holding a staff with a flag bearing a cross. Two other figures are seen crouching near the structure, both looking away, one with a hood and the other with a helmet. The colors are limited but create a distinct and simple representation. This is in the style of an early Christian or medieval religious illustration, reminiscent of woodcut prints often seen in religious texts from the period.

artworks.title: Noli me tangere
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 11.1 x 8 cm (4 3/8 x 3 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from head to toe. The figure on the left is standing upright, facing slightly towards the other figure, and gesturing with one hand. They have a halo, long dark hair, a beard, and wear a long red robe. The figure on the right is kneeling, looking up at the standing figure with hands clasped together. They also have a halo, light-colored wavy hair, and wear a long robe. In the background, there is a simplistic tree with a green top, a fence-like pattern, and a grassy green ground. A small brown object is near the kneeling figure's feet.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 11.1 x 7.9 cm (4 3/8 x 3 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene in a medieval style. The image depicts a seated, haloed figure holding a staff with a floral motif in one hand and raising the other, which bears a mark. This figure is dressed in flowing robes and is positioned centrally and above the ground. Below, two figures are kneeling with their hands clasped. Between these kneeling figures, two smaller figures emerge from the ground, similarly positioned with clasped hands. The scene is set against a simple background, suggesting a heavenly or spiritual realm. This is in the style of an anonymous medieval artist, characteristic of religious iconography from that period.
